Meta.title: Wurzelwerk — Bistro in Vienna
Meta.description: Seasonal, vegetable-forward cooking in Vienna-Margareten. A menu with clear vegan, vegetarian and allergen labelling.

Home.headline: Cooked seasonally, thought from the root up.
Home.subtitle: A menu that starts with the vegetable, not the meat — and states plainly what's vegan, vegetarian or allergen-free.

seasonal.title: Seasonal & regional
seasonal.body: The menu changes with the harvest, not the calendar year.

labelled.title: Clearly labelled
labelled.body: Every dish shows vegan, vegetarian or allergens right on the menu — not only on request.

noPhoneQueue.title: No phone queue
noPhoneQueue.body: Reservations and contact are reachable any time, even outside opening hours.

Menu.metaDescription: Starters, mains and desserts with clear vegan, vegetarian and allergen labelling.
Menu.title: Menu
Menu.subtitle: Seasonal, vegetable-forward — every dish with dietary and allergen labelling.

rote-bete-carpaccio.name: Beetroot carpaccio
rote-bete-carpaccio.description: With fresh goat cheese, toasted walnut crumble and apple vinaigrette.

kuerbissuppe.name: Pumpkin soup
kuerbissuppe.description: With roasted pumpkin-seed oil and seeds.

wurzelgemuese-tarte.name: Root vegetable tart
wurzelgemuese-tarte.description: With king oyster mushrooms and mountain cheese.

geschmorte-pastinake.name: Braised parsnip
geschmorte-pastinake.description: With lentil ragout and parsley-root purée.

saiblingsfilet.name: Arctic char fillet
saiblingsfilet.description: With root vegetables and beurre blanc.

rindsragout.name: Beef ragout
rindsragout.description: From pasture-raised beef, with root vegetables and mashed potatoes.

sellerie-steak.name: Celeriac steak
sellerie-steak.description: Grilled, with chimichurri and toasted buckwheat.
